lines.text: Many learners say: I tried sushi, but I didn't like.
Better: I tried sushi, but I didn't like it.
Didn't like it! I tried sushi, but I didn't like it.

native.hook: 文末に it が抜けてない？
native.tip: like のあとには「何を」が必要。ここでは it を入れます。
native.caption: “I tried sushi, but I didn't like.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は話の中で分かる言葉を省くので、英語でも省きがちです。“I tried sushi, but I didn't like it.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“didn't like it”。“I tried sushi, but I didn't like it.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Isn't it missing at the end of the
en.tip: Like needs something after it: like it.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I tried sushi, but I didn't like.” 😅 Japanese often skips the thing you talk about, but English needs it. The natural way is “I tried sushi, but I didn't like it.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
